description: RedS41ft shared preset — ACTIVE repos. Non-major updates automerge behind CI as soon as checks pass; majors and core frameworks wait for review. New branches open on a daily check.

packageRules.description: Automerge all non-major updates once checks pass
Majors open a PR but never automerge — surfaced by Monday digest
Core frameworks get their own PR and manual review even on minor

typescript-eslint has no TS 7 support and none is imminent (ESLint needs async-parser support first, which the maintainers called 'many months away' as of Sept 2026 - see typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940). It hard-errors on import under TS 7, it's not just a stale peer range. Hold at TS 6 until that lands, then remove this rule.

Python runtime (.python-version): a minor bump (3.14 -> 3.15) changes the interpreter, has to match the repo's Docker base image (which Renovate does not track), and may land on a pre-release. Open a PR for review instead of automerging. Patch bumps still automerge.
